notes: Plan 00B-3 C0 — the executable derivability contract SCHEMA, authored BEFORE any C1-C5 implementation (the anti-shaping rule). Both fixture files and all producer adapters are validated against THIS document.

Layer split: evidence_projection_v1 covers ONLY facts derivable from the five-key allowlisted completion snapshot {sessionId, boundary, counts, revisions, sub_records}. The 00C-owned manifest ENVELOPE (trusted timestamps/status, deployment identity, content addressing, publication receipts) is EXCLUDED and never reconstructed from sub_records.
The asynchronous PRODUCER_KINDS counter registry (plan00-lifecycle-hooks.js) is a SEPARATE contract, deliberately NOT replaced by producer_registry below.

Spoken text / model prose is EXCLUDED from every sub-record by design (00C: transcript, model prose, tool payloads and customer data stay out of manifests). Text lives only in the evaluation-side delivery-ledger rows.

Ordering rule: the sub_records array order IS the global event order (append-only, replay-deterministic). delivery rows additionally carry the delivery ledger's monotonic at_seq and a stable delivery_ref derived from it.

Ordering (Codex r1 A-1/B-7): the sub_records array order IS the global event order; evidence_projection_v1 stamps each projected delivery/playback/idempotent/rejected/ambiguity event with `seq` = its sub_records array index at projection time, so grouped projections retain the cross-class interleaving the fold's ordering rules need. Trusted wall-clock timestamps remain 00C ENVELOPE facts by the layer split — never reconstructed from sub_records.

quiescence_count_keys.open_asks_dispatcher: open (produced|emitted) askLedger entries whose registry quiescence_family is dispatcher, plus entries terminal-resolved with a stop-boundary terminal

ask_terminals.rule: The dispatcher's terminal vocabulary is open-ended, so quiescence compatibility is defined by the CLOSED non-quiescent set: an entry terminal-resolved with a stop_boundary_non_quiescent member still counts in its family's open_asks_* key; ANY other terminal closes the entry as quiescence-compatible. An ask still open AT the stop boundary renders the completion freeze INELIGIBLE even if stop-expiry later terminal-resolves it, and the latched completion freeze can never be flipped eligible by a post-freeze resolution. Codex r1 (B-5): `unknown_terminal` (the dispatcher's explicit fallback when an outcome carries no reason) also counts NON-quiescent — a genuinely unknown outcome must not quietly close an ask.

producer_registry_rules: recordAskProduced / recordDelivery / playback recording accept REGISTRY IDs only, never free-form family or transport strings; families and transports are DERIVED from the registry entry (one derivation).

An UNKNOWN producer id appends an uncreditable producer_unknown row and marks the owning ledger invalid (event_class ask -> askLedger, delivery|playback -> deliveryLedger) — fail-loud, never silent absence.

Null semantic_family is legal ONLY for event_class ask (pure ask producers can never reach delivery/playback rows); a delivery or playback append citing a null-semantic-family producer id is a registry violation.
Every semantic_families member has at least one producer (reverse-direction exhaustiveness, unscoped).

fields.stage: produced | emitted | reissued_attempt | resolved | replaced | join_expired
fields.replaces_runtime_id: string|null, produced stage only — the predecessor runtime id when this ask REPLACES a broker predecessor (carries the lineage for link-only replacements of already-terminal predecessors)

ask_lifecycle.rule: Appended ONLY when the owning askLedger ACCEPTED the transition (the row is derived from the ledger verdict — one derivation, never a parallel append).

fields.family: ask_quiescence_families member or null when unresolvable

ask_transition_rejected.rule: Every REJECTED ask-ledger transition attempt appends exactly one of these (mutually exclusive with the accepted row). Projects zero lifecycle credit. Distinct discriminator so a sub-records-only fold can never mistake it for credit.

fields.op_keys: array of canonical operation identity keys
fields.delivery_claim_token: string|null — the PERSISTED outbox delivery-claim token (process lineage) on address-mirror rows; claim_lineage stays the logical `kind:token` ACK alias

delivery_evidence.rule: The legacy overloaded `family` key (which carried the TRANSPORT) is retired; semantic_family and transport are separate fields. No spoken text on the row. EXCEPTION: a delivery_kind=delivery_history_ambiguous row is an UNCREDITABLE recovery marker (discriminated by delivery_kind, never projected as delivery credit) and carries delivery_ref:null/at_seq:null — it marks operations, not a send.

delivery_rejected.rule: An attempted operation-backed delivery whose receipt binding failed. Visible-but-uncreditable; always paired with the delivery_invalid structural latch.

fields.ack_body_hash: sha256 hex of the canonical ACK body

playback_evidence.rule: One row per AUTHORITATIVE playback start (the delivery ledger accepted the ACK as a new playback_start row).

fields.op_key: canonical operation identity key of the EXISTING authoritative playback
fields.ack_body_hash: sha256 hex — byte-identical to the existing authoritative row's hash

playback_idempotent.rule: A byte-identical ACK retransmission: accepted-IDEMPOTENT verdict, keyed to the existing authoritative event, projects NO additional credit and never affects eligibility.

playback_rejected.rule: An integrity-rejected ACK that reached the ledger admission layer (post pre-admission). Pre-admission unmatched/wrong/stale/zero-or-ambiguous slot resolutions are NOT transition attempts: they stay telemetry and append NO row.

fields.api_transport: anthropic_messages | chat_completions | responses | null — WHICH API served the round (adapter-stamped actual transport, never configuration)

fields.reason: string|null (the latch reason; null for delivery_prepared_outstanding)

freeze_invalid.rule: Canonical freeze-time rows, appended inside freezeEvidenceCompletion AFTER ctx.settleFastTts() and the direct assertNoUnconsumedProvisionals() fold, BEFORE the revisionsBefore read. CONDITION-GATED: appended only when the condition holds, never a zero/null placeholder. Any freeze_invalid row renders the session INELIGIBLE for 00C family credit (fold HOLD/INVALID). Unconsumed fast-TTS provisionals reach this class by folding into the delivery_invalid latch (reason fast_provisional_unconsumed) via the EXISTING non-throwing assertNoUnconsumedProvisionals — never a parallel derivation.

producer_unknown.rule: Appended when a record* API receives a producer id absent from producer_registry; the owning ledger is marked invalid. Any producer_unknown row renders the session INELIGIBLE.

fields.note: production-shaped frame descriptor; not consumed by evidence_projection_v1
production-shaped delivery descriptor; not consumed by evidence_projection_v1

answered_without_full_proof.note: SANCTIONED behaviour change to the shipped ledger: a rejected answered resolution produces ONLY the rejected audit row, does NOT latch invalid, and leaves the entry 'emitted' so it counts non-quiescent at stop. askLedger.resolved() returns {accepted, reason} instead of undefined.

fast_ack_without_provisional.note: Codex r1 (C-2): a wrong/stale/unknown fast-TTS correlation is PRE-ADMISSION telemetry — no row, no latch; a later valid ACK succeeds. Reclassified from structural_latch during the diff review (the C1 ternary's wrong/stale rule).

fast_provisional_unconsumed.note: Freeze-time fold only: assertNoUnconsumedProvisionals() latches delivery_invalid; the condition reaches sub_records as the delivery_invalid freeze_invalid row.

unknown_rejection_reason.note: Fail-loud fallback when a rejected-append helper receives a reason outside this closed vocabulary — the vocabulary stays closed because an unregistered reason cannot ship silently.

verdict_taxonomy.pre_admission: Unmatched/wrong/stale/zero-or-ambiguous slot or correlation resolutions filtered ABOVE the ledger admission layer are NOT transition attempts: no row, no latch — telemetry only (the judge's missing-playback negatives read the absence). A later valid ACK for the same operation succeeds normally.
verdict_taxonomy.accepted: Exactly one accepted transition row, derived from the ledger verdict.
verdict_taxonomy.accepted_idempotent: A byte-identical playback retransmission: playback_idempotent audit row keyed to the existing authoritative event; no additional credit; never invalidating.
verdict_taxonomy.rejected: Exactly one rejected audit row per rejection_reasons regime; structural_latch reasons additionally latch the owning ledger invalid.

named_fixture_case_composition.freeze: INELIGIBLE via non_quiescent_at_stop (the rejected ask remains open and counts in its family's open_asks_* key); NO ask_invalid latch and NO freeze_invalid row from this rejection alone.

dialogue_script.ask_lifecycle_complete: at least one dialogue_script ask with produced+emitted+resolved(answered) accepted rows
dialogue_script.operation_bound_delivery: at least one delivery_evidence row with semantic_family dialogue_script and non-empty op_keys

address_mirror.ask_lifecycle_complete: at least one address_mirror ask with produced+emitted+resolved(answered) accepted rows, where applicable
address_mirror.operation_bound_delivery: at least one delivery_evidence row with semantic_family address_mirror and non-empty op_keys
address_mirror.playback_ack_proof: at least one playback_evidence row with semantic_family address_mirror (the address_mirror_delivery_ack producer)

family_gate_rules.zero_credit_rule: Rejected/idempotent/unknown/freeze rows grant zero produced/emitted/resolved/delivery/playback family credit; any session_ineligibility_row_class row makes the whole session's family evidence INELIGIBLE (fold HOLD/INVALID).
